verdict.stance: Constructive / QatarEnergy-Contracted LNG Shipping Monopoly (AA- / A+)
verdict.summary: Nakilat is the world's largest LNG carrier owner, contracted under long-term ship-or-pay charters to QatarEnergy generating QAR 4.78bn FY25 total income and QAR 3.55bn EBITDA. Fitch's AA- (Senior Secured) and A+ (Subordinated) ratings incorporate a 2-notch sovereign/QatarEnergy uplift above standalone profiles ('a'/'a-') as the fleet expands toward 112 vessels for North Field.

positives: Long-term fixed-rate time charters with QatarEnergy (AA/Aa2) eliminate spot LNG freight volatility.
Fitch AA- / A+ ratings backed by two-notch Qatar state/QatarEnergy strategic support uplift.
Minimal 2026 maintenance capex ($10m-$15m) after 2025 dry-docking completion.
negatives: Large multi-billion dollar newbuild capex for North Field LNG expansion lifts consolidated debt (~QAR 21.4bn).
Heavy single-offtaker concentration to QatarEnergy and Strait of Hormuz transit geopolitics.
Amortizing project bond and bank facility debt-service schedules require sustained charter uptime.
